title: Game mode state diagram
description: What a Game is doing. step() simulates the world only in play; in the other modes it counts frames and shows an animation.

states.description: A stage has just been built; the hero stands still and GET READY shows for 80 frames.
The hero, the ape's throws, barrels or pies, fireballs, springs, lifts, belts, hammer, pickups and the bonus clock are all simulated.
The hero is spinning or lying down for 110 frames; the world is frozen.
The stage is won: the bonus has been added to the score and the 220-frame celebration runs (on the rivets stage the ape falls).
The last life is lost. The page waits for a key or a tap and returns to the title.

transitions.trigger: a barrel, pie, fireball or spring touches the hero, a fall of more than 30 pixels, or the bonus reaching 0
110 frames elapse with no lives left
the hero reaches the captive's platform, or the last rivet is removed
transitions.action: the bonus is added to the score
the next stage is built; after the last stage of a round, the next round begins
